en.title: Land surveyor: the work, the rules and how to start
en.seo_title: Land surveyor: work, rules, how to start
en.meta_description: What a land surveyor does, which international classification covers the trade, what remains unverified per country, and how to set up as an independent.
en.excerpt: A short illustration of the guide format: two sections, one question, two primary sources.
en.intro: This example shows the shape of one guide page. A real page is much longer and is written for its own item.

sections.heading: What does a land surveyor do?
sections.body: The international classification of occupations groups surveyors with cartographers under unit group 2165 [s:ilo-isco-08].

sections.heading: How the site helps
sections.body: Signing up is free and creates a public profile. It is not a job offer.

faq.a: In most countries the title is protected by law; the rule for each country is listed with its source, and shown as not verified yet when the official text was not found [s:fig-about].
